text: Mara's Python automation from Lessons 8 and 9 runs its regular pull against the OT and SCADA boundary on October 12 -- the exact same cutoff date the compliance audit used. It wasn't built in response to the audit; it was already running on its own schedule.

The audit checked group membership only. The automation was built to check two things: group membership in the same two groups, plus any direct, individually-assigned Entra ID role or AWS IAM policy attached straight to an account.

The automation reports 19 accounts with standing admin access to the OT and SCADA segment -- the same 14 the audit found via group membership, plus 5 more found only through direct, individual assignment.

Mara's first move is not to decide which number is right. A discrepancy only proves one method is measuring something the other isn't -- which account-by-account comparison, next lesson, is built to resolve.
